mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (from_user_id, to_user_id, content, is_read) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT cm.id, cm.from_user_id, cm.to_user_id, cm.content, cm.is_read, cm.create_time FROM chat_message cm WHERE cm.id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM chat_message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END ) ORDER BY cm.id DESC

SELECT id, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, is_read, create_time FROM chat_message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{peerId}) OR (from_user_id = #{peerId} AND to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT from_user_id AS peerId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY from_user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND from_user_id = #{peerId} AND is_read = 0
